title: solenostemon thyrsiflorus
intro: Solenostemon thyrsiflorus, commonly known as Coleus, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family, known for its vibrant flowers and medicinal properties. The Coleus plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin problems, due to its numerous health benefits. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids. These compounds contribute to the Coleus plant's ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and protect against oxidative stress.
